required_corrections_to_supplied_closure.correction: Six calibration stages were preserved under repository provenance. Four stages involved genuine model execution (V2, V3B, V4.1, V4.1R); V3 and V4 were design-only/not executed. V4.1 was preserved but gate-ineligible because of protocol deviation.

required_corrections_to_supplied_closure.original_claim: The structural relation set independently validated in Sequence 4 enters Sequence 6 directly.
required_corrections_to_supplied_closure.correction: Sequence 4 supports relation survival within its stated same-host/context-isolated scope. It does not constitute independent external or exogenous validation. Sequence 6 may admit those relations only with that scope preserved.
Retain only as the preregistered gate label. It means variance was driven by a single pair; it does not establish that PAIR_04 itself is scientifically trivial.

stop_rule_audit.finding: The decision to stop after V4.1R is a post-result scientific-governance judgment, not a preregistered stopping rule.
stop_rule_audit.rationale: After repeated non-identifying calibration attempts, designing a further pilot primarily to force K1/K2 separation would introduce substantial researcher degrees of freedom and result-seeking risk.
stop_rule_audit.future_work_boundary: Do not create Pilot V5 as another Sequence 5.5 calibration rescue. A future study is permissible only as a separately named, freshly preregistered program motivated by an independently stated hypothesis, new receiver/generalization question, or externally specified task family rather than by a desired K1/K2 separation.

canonical_countersigned_statement: At Gemini 3.8 Flash / medium / Vercel-preview under the receiver-clean V4.1R relational-contrast tasks, the preregistered pair-success assay did not identify an incremental Aperture effect over matched scaffolding or conventional engineering. K3 uniquely matched the preregistered Pair-04 transition in this episode, but the episode failed the preregistered methodological-identification, pairwise-spread, and dynamic-range criteria. That single-pair signal is therefore hypothesis-generating only. Sequence 5.5 closes with the main battery sealed and unexecuted. No Pilot V5 is authorized within this calibration program; any future test must begin as a separately preregistered study rather than a rescue iteration aimed at obtaining treatment separation.
